title: Synthetic Observability Data Generation using GANs
summary: An ITU AI/ML in 5G Challenge project (ML5G-PS-009) that generates synthetic network observability data using a GAN-based tabular synthesizer. Its Sample.py reimplements CTGAN's Residual/Generator/DataTransformer/CTGANSynthesizer classes and directly imports rdt's BayesGMMTransformer and OneHotEncodingTransformer for preprocessing, making CTGAN and RDT vendored and adapted into the project's own synthesis pipeline.
evidence: Sample.py:283 'class Residual(Module): """Residual layer for the CTGANSynthesizer."""'; Sample.py:15-16 'import rdt; from rdt.transformers import BayesGMMTransformer, OneHotEncodingTransformer'
needs: Confirm whether Sample.py's CTGANSynthesizer is a modified copy of the ctgan package or an independent reimplementation sharing docstrings; no README to verify authorship or purpose in detail.
